claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean, but internal mechanical condition and tire tread cannot be confirmed from a single photo.

risks.risk: The drivetrain (gears and chain) may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the bike being pedaled through all gear positions.

risks.risk: The tires may be worn, dry-rotted, or have hidden punctures.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tread and sidewalls of both tires.

risks.risk: The brakes may be worn or the brake pads may be missing.
risks.proof: A video showing the brakes being applied and the wheels stopping.

risks.risk: The bike may have structural cracks or rust in the frame.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the frame joints and the underside of the bike.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike being pedaled to confirm the drivetrain and gears work.
Close-up photos of the tires to check for wear and dry rot.
Video of the brakes being operated.
Photos of the frame joints and the underside of the bike.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
